# Pesher Psalms Column 1 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 4QpPs (4Q171), Col. 1 | **Condition:** fragmentary

---

**1:1** [...] "Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; fret not over him who prospers in his way, over the man who carries out evil devices" (Psalm 37:7).

**1:2** [...] and those who turn back from [...]

**1:3** Its interpretation concerns the Man of the Lie, who led many astray with deceitful words, for they chose worthless things and did not heed

**1:4** the Interpreter of Knowledge, who [...]

**1:5** [...] they shall perish by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence.

**1:6** "For yet a little while, and the wicked shall be no more; you will look carefully at his place, and he will not be there" (Psalm 37:10).

**1:7** Its interpretation concerns all the wickedness at the end of forty years, when

**1:8** they are consumed, and there will not be found on the earth any wicked man.

**1:9** "But the meek shall inherit the land and shall delight in abundant peace" (Psalm 37:11).

**1:10** Its interpretation concerns the Congregation of the Poor, who accept the time of affliction and shall be delivered

**1:11** from all the snares of Belial. Afterward, they shall delight in all the [...] of

**1:12** the earth, and shall feast on every delicacy of the flesh.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from 4Q171, Col. 1. "Pesher" rendered as "interpretation" for clarity. "Man of the Lie" and "Interpreter of Knowledge" capitalized as established sectarian titles. "Congregation of the Poor" (adat ha-evyonim) — a self-designation of the Qumran community. The forty-year period alludes to the expected duration before the eschatological consummation. Psalm quotations follow the MT closely with minor variants attested in 4Q171.*
